items: 【CRAFTED TO LAST】Featuring a sturdy solid wood frame (2.8'' thick) and coated with quality varnish for a smooth, polished finish, this towel rack ensures durability and longevity. It's ideal for holding towels, blankets, or storing decorations and books

【CONVENIENT HANGING SOLUTIONS】3 robust metal hooks with stylish synthetic leather straps and 8 additional side hooks offer versatility for all your daily hanging needs. Easily hang your scarves, bags, and other accessories, keeping everything within reach
【EASY TO ASSEMBLE】With pre-assembled frames, easy-to-follow instructions and numbered parts, you can effortlessly put this quilt ladder together in just 10 minutes

【SPACE-SAVING DESIGN】The beveled top design allows this wooden blanket ladder to lean against the wall, occupying only 2.2 ft², fitting perfectly into room corners and saving valuable floor space for you
【FRIENDLY TO WALL & FLOOR】The beveled top of the ladder shelf and the bottom of the legs are equipped with thick felt pads to prevent scratching your wall and floor
